compiled_state.title: test-index: 5 RED markers missing from runner.py entry after 771d story PR merge
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 2443c4260ac8e6562f7eb863a22030fd62882ad1

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker (post-merge cleanup)

#### Expected Behavior

After PR #110 (story 771d) merged, the .test-index entry for runner.py should include all RED test markers written as part of the 771d TDD cycle, including: test_read_config_int_handles_whitespace_around_equals, test_clamp_schema_correction_attempts_rejects_negative, test_get_schema_correction_max_attempts_end_to_end, test_get_schema_correction_max_attempts_clamps_negative, test_get_schema_correction_max_attempts_clamps_above_ceiling.

Also: validate-config.sh review.* keys should be sorted alphabetically in KNOWN_KEYS array per established convention.

#### Actual Behavior

PR #110 was merged at HEAD=6bf1772a4d. Post-merge commits 9fe6522f62 and 71196a6659 (which added the 5 missing markers and the sort fix) were NOT included in the merge. These 2 commits remain on the story branch only.

The 5 test functions exist in test_runner_smoke.py and pass (GREEN), but are not tracked in the .test-index RED marker list. The pre-commit test gate will treat them as untracked (not enforced as RED during future development against runner.py).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] .test-index entry for runner.py contains test_read_config_int_handles_whitespace_around_equals
  Verify: grep -q 'test_read_config_int_handles_whitespace_around_equals' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
- [ ] .test-index entry for runner.py contains test_clamp_schema_correction_attempts_rejects_negative
  Verify: grep -q 'test_clamp_schema_correction_attempts_rejects_negative' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
- [ ] .test-index entry for runner.py contains test_get_schema_correction_max_attempts_end_to_end
  Verify: grep -q 'test_get_schema_correction_max_attempts_end_to_end' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
- [ ] .test-index entry for runner.py contains test_get_schema_correction_max_attempts_clamps_negative
  Verify: grep -q 'test_get_schema_correction_max_attempts_clamps_negative' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
- [ ] .test-index entry for runner.py contains test_get_schema_correction_max_attempts_clamps_above_ceiling
  Verify: grep -q 'test_get_schema_correction_max_attempts_clamps_above_ceiling' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
- [ ] validate-config.sh KNOWN_KEYS array for review.* keys is sorted alphabetically
  Verify: grep -A 50 'KNOWN_KEYS' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/validate-config.sh | grep 'review\.' | sort -c 2>/dev/null && echo sorted
- [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh passes (exit 0) after changes
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/run-all.sh
